title: Zoology: Bio-Diversity & Its Conservation Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Zoology Bio-Diversity Chapter

cards.q: What does IUCN stand for in the context of worldwide environmental organizations?
cards.a: International Union for Conservation of Nature.

cards.q: What is the National Aquatic Animal of India?
What is the State Animal and State Bird of Tamil Nadu?
cards.a: State Animal: Nilgiri Tahr; State Bird: Emerald Dove.

cards.q: According to the text, what is the total number of animal species recorded in India?
What is the primary difference in resource extraction between a National Park and a Wildlife Sanctuary?
cards.a: In a National Park, harvesting timber and collection of forest products are restricted, whereas in a Wildlife Sanctuary, they are allowed with permission.

cards.q: How many National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries are there in India according to the text?
Which was the first Biosphere Reserve established in India and in which year?
Which is the first Marine Biosphere Reserve in India?
How many Biosphere Reserves in India are recognized by UNESCO?
cards.a: 11 out of the 18 total Biosphere Reserves in India.

cards.q: Which National Park in Tamil Nadu was created specifically to protect the keystone species, the Nilgiri Tahr?
Which is the largest National Park in Tamil Nadu?
cards.a: Indira Gandhi National Park (formerly Annamalai NP) in Coimbatore.

cards.q: Which Wildlife Sanctuary in Tamil Nadu is known for the Grizzled Giant Squirrel?
Which is the largest Wildlife Sanctuary in Tamil Nadu and also has the maximum tiger resident area?
Which is the oldest bird sanctuary in Tamil Nadu, established in 1936?
Under Project Elephant (1992), name the four elephant reserves located in Tamil Nadu.
